items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Griffin's brother' in the context of a local resident ('He used to... He was here') and a deceased person ('He passed, though'), with no indication of a musical or personal relationship with the interviewee.

ctx.x: He got destroyed in the fire. I didn't know that. That, that, that was this band, the band. And, uh, his madam, she won't take it over and handle it. But, uh, now Griffin, the boy here now that, going in the band playing piano, he's here. He's working, uh, just, he's entertaining. He can sing, and he work by himself. He do mostly all the, uh, jobs and, around here now, right now. He's here. He's about your size. Not as big as Bud, though, huh? Not quite as big as Bud. There's lots of people thought that he was…
Well, did, would you say that Bud weighed 250 pounds? Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Just last week, Tom and I was trying to... Was thinking about that same thing.

ctx.x: Well, she got it from Griffin's brother, huh?

Griffin's brother. Tom Griffin's brother. His brother. Come see. Oh, yes, ma'am. Well, hi. And Mr... He used to... He used to... He was here and his father used to handle their potato chips and so forth. I think he lives... He passed, though. He is. Is this your home here?
This is my home, but I don't remember.
